game.title: Persona 4 Golden
game.blurb: Role-playing game of school life, Social Links and Persona battles, from Atlus (P Studio), released 2012-11-20; RAWG lists PS Vita, PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox and Nintendo Switch versions. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The mystery in Inaba, case by case. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden on Steam.

chapters.title: Personas, Fusion and the Compendium
chapters.summary: Obtaining Izanagi, fusing Personas, fusion accidents, Skill Cards and filling the Compendium.

chapters.title: Social Links
chapters.summary: Maxing out Social Links, a special relationship and every social quality.

chapters.title: Daily Life in Inaba
chapters.summary: Exams, books, fishing, bug catching, boxed lunches, shops, the vending and capsule machines, movies, coffee and the Miracle Quiz.

chapters.title: Battle Skills
chapters.summary: All-Out Attacks, weaknesses, Sweep Bonuses, big hits, Golden Hands, costumes and Rise's navigation.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1113000)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Persona_4_Golden
Fandom (megamitensei.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Persona_4_Golden
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only "Achievements and trophies" (about 6,200 characters), "Controls" (about 2,100) and a near-empty "Table of Contents" (about 110) exist, with no walkthrough, so nothing was used. megamitensei.fandom.com answers the API, with about 466 linked pages, including "Chie Satonaka", "Daily Life", "Cooking" and "Calendar/Persona 4"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Day" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1113000 as "Persona 4 Golden". 14 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though some ("Special Fusion Expert", "The Reaper Becomes the Reaped", "One Who Has Proven Their Power", "Big Bro is Worried") may be side goals. The all-achievements goal "Golden Completed" was also put in the main story chapter. "Inaba" in the summaries comes from the achievement "Legend of Inaba".
